items.title: New Russian KUB-10ME attack drone reportedly photographed by Ukrainian side
items.summary: A Ukrainian-released photograph reportedly shows Russia's KUB-10ME drone, described as the second public indication of its possible use in two months. The reported system pairs a 35 kg strike drone carrying an 11 kg warhead, with a range of up to 120 km, and a SKAT 350 M reconnaissance and relay drone.

items.title: Kushner calls for security arrangement addressing Ukraine, NATO and Russia
items.summary: Jared Kushner said a future security settlement should protect Ukraine, strengthen Europe and reassure Russia that NATO is not seeking confrontation, while giving NATO members confidence that Russia will respect neighboring countries' sovereignty and security.

items.title: Russian Defence Ministry describes infiltration tactics in claimed Dobropillia capture
items.summary: Russia's Defence Ministry said marines from its Center grouping concentrated assault forces and infiltrated Ukrainian positions during what it described as the capture of Dobropillia in the Donetsk region. The statement described Russian tactics rather than providing a new independently established change in territorial control.
